curseforge.name: WarPads Classic
curseforge.summary: It allows you to warp instantly to any saved destination, even if it's in another dimension.  Yes—you read that right. Nether, End, Overworld—all just one block away.
curseforge.description:
🌀 WarPads Classic

Instant Travel with Style | Created by GamerFile
Originally uploaded under the alias SuperD (mcpedl.com/user/superd) on MCPEDL
Published here: mcpedl.com/warpads — 2 years ago

🧽 Tired of running for ages?

Have you ever thought: "Ugh, it takes forever to get there..."?
Then you're in luck—because WarPads are here!

This addon gives you a powerful and fun way to teleport across your world (and even dimensions!) by simply placing a custom block and interacting with it.

🔧 What is WarPads?

The addon adds a powerful block called the Warp Block.

It looks like this:
📷

Once placed and configured, these blocks allow you to warp instantly to any saved destination, even if it's in another dimension.

Yes—you read that right.
Nether, End, Overworld—all just one block away.

🛠️ How to Use

⚠️ Make sure Beta APIs are enabled in your world settings!

🔹 Getting the Block

You can obtain the Warp Block in three ways:

  • Creative Inventory
    → Found in the Construction category
    📷

  • .

  • Crafting Table (Survival)

  • Commands

    /give @s warp:block  
/setblock  
/fill

🔹 Setting a Warp

  1. Place the Warp Block.

  2. Interact with it (tap, right-click, or long-press) to open the naming menu.

    • Example: name it "Home" or "Castle"

  3. Interact again to open the Warp Menu.

  4. Choose your saved location—BOOM, you’re teleported!

    • A message will confirm:

      “Successfully warped to [warp name]”

📷

🔹 Cross-Dimensional Travel

Want to go from Nether to End instantly? Or End to Overworld?
No problem—Warpads work across all dimensions.
(Just make sure both ends are named and placed properly!)

🔹 Picking Up the Block

Warp Blocks can’t be broken in survival (to prevent accidental removal),
but you can still pick them up:

  • Sneak + Interact with the block
    📷

A confirmation popup ensures you don’t do it by mistake.

📦 What's in This Version?

🔧 This is an incomplete version of Warpads Classic. Big changes and improvements are coming in future versions!

  • ✅ Support for Minecraft 1.21

  • 🎨 Redesigned menu colors for readability

  • ✍️ Added Rename Option for warp blocks

  • 📊 Operator-only commands:

    • !warp open – open warp menu directly

    • !warp create – create warp via coordinates (requires loaded chunks)

  • ⚠️ Confirmation popup when picking up blocks

  • 🧠 Improved error messages and bug fixes

  • 🌈 Refined chat message colors

❗ Known Issue

  • Using !warp create in unloaded chunks may cause the block not to appear.
    Make sure the target area is loaded before using.

📌 Notes

  • This is the Classic version — designed primarily for creative or utility-focused gameplay.

  • A survival-friendly version with 2-pad linking and fuel system is in the works.

  • Operator-only commands can be fun but aren’t recommended for balanced survival.

  • Beta APIs must be turned on for this addon to function properly.

✉️ Feedback & Support

curseforge.name: Nytheris - The Jealous Relic
curseforge.summary: Master a sentient, jealous blade that rewards loyalty with devastating physics-based combat skills.
curseforge.description:
Nytheris – The Jealous Relic (v1.1.0)

"It will stay with you, orbit you, defend you… unless you betray it."

Nytheris is a sentient artifact forged in the cold glow of a lunar ritual. It does not simply “belong” to its wielder — it bonds with them. It follows in silent orbit, striking foes in its passive state and unleashing devastating force when hurled with precision. But Nytheris is possessive: carry more than one and they will reject you. Drop it carelessly, and it may not return.

🔥 Features

🌌 Passive Orbit

Nytheris circles you, dealing collision damage to nearby foes. As you level up, its damage adapt to protect its master.

☄️ Aimed Throw

Hold its bound item, aim, and release. Nytheris uses a custom physics engine (3D Vector Math) to fly with momentum, drill through blocks, and return to your hand.

🌑 New in v1.1.0: The Moonbinding Ritual

No creative inventory needed.

  1. Seek: Find the Record of the Moonbinder in Stronghold Libraries.
  2. Gather: Crying Obsidian, Amethyst, Gold, and the Moon Shard (which also drops in Strongholds and in Ancient City).
  3. Forge: Build the Moonbinding Altar, place the tribute, and wait for a Full Moon.

💫 New in v1.1.0: Apex Skills (Level 4)

Reach the pinnacle of bonding to unlock:

  • The Grip: Hold Right Click to seize enemies with telekinesis.
  • Flick-Release: Whiplash your camera to launch gripped mobs into the void.
  • Phase Jump: Sneak + Release Throw to blink instantly to the blade's location.

🩸 Sentient Bond (Envy)

Owning more than one Nytheris will cause Betrayal. The blade will leave you. Treat it with respect.

🪄 FunTools Addon

For Minecraft Bedrock & MCPE | Made by GamerFile

📌 Overview

This is an admin tools addon that gives you access to a variety of powerful utilities—all through a simple stick and intuitive in-game menu. Whether you're handling a server, managing a chaotic multiplayer world, or just want to have fun, these tools are built to give you instant control with ease.

More tools will be added on demand or based on feedback. So feel free to suggest what you’d like to see next!

  1. Get a stick (any stick).

  3. Sneak + Tap (place button) while holding the stick to open the menu.

  4. Alternatively, use any of the following commands to access the tools menu (works even with cheats off):
    !tm, !toolm, !menu, !tool, !tmenu, !toolmenu

curseforge.name: Trapify - Block Functions
curseforge.summary: 🎮 Want a block that explodes when broken? 🧨 How about a teleport trap when stepped on? 📩 Or a hidden message when someone clicks a block?  With Trapify, you get full control over block behavior with a simple-to-use UI.
curseforge.description:
🔥 Trapify – Block Function Addon for Minecraft Bedrock

Turn any block into a trap. Surprise, punish, or prank like a pro.

✨ What Is Trapify?

Trapify is an advanced Minecraft Bedrock addon that lets you assign custom actions to any block in your world. It transforms ordinary blocks into programmable traps or functional utilities triggered on:

  • 🖱️ Click

  • 🧱 Break

  • 🦶 Step

Unlike traditional command blocks or redstone contraptions, Trapify is a modular system powered by a special wand and a smooth UI — allowing you to set traps or functions with simple, readable commands.

🔧 Core Features

🪄 Trapify Wand Tool

  • A unique item Trapify Wand used to interact with blocks.

  • Left-click or hold on a block to open a UI and assign a trap.

  • Prevents accidental destruction — blocks become protected from break when wand is used.

⚡ Three Trigger Types:

Type Description
OnClick Activated when the block is interacted with
OnBreak Triggered upon breaking the block
OnStep Runs when a player walks over the block
 

💬 Custom Action Input (Command Style)

Use a simple syntax to assign one or multiple commands:

tf message "You fell for it!"; tf countdown 3; tf explode; tf teleport 10 70 -5

  • Chain multiple actions using ;

  • Designed like a mini domain-specific language (DSL)

🎭 Action Types Supported:

Current trap actions include:

  • explode, teleport, freeze, launch, lightning, damage

  • message, title, actionbar, countdown, effect, sound

  • blind, confusion, levitate, push, spin, and more...

🧱 In-Game UI

  • Modal form interface for assigning traps.

  • Future updates will include:

    • Preset dropdowns

    • Advanced Mode toggles

    • Multi-page or extended input handling

🧠 Use Cases

  • 🗺️ Adventure Maps: Design puzzles, jumpscares, or lore triggers

  • 😈 Trolling Friends: Exploding chests, fake ores, or prank messages

  • 🎯 Minigames: Area-based traps without relying on ticking command blocks

  • ⚔️ PvP Arenas: Step-triggered buffs, debuffs, or audio cues

  • 🧱 Redstone Replacements: Traps with logic, no circuits

  • 🧙 RP Servers: Lore events, auto-quests

  • 🧑‍🏫 Education: Teach logic with readable trap commands

💡 Why Trapify?

Trapify doesn’t just mimic redstone or command blocks —
It gives you developer-level control inside survival mode.

Whether you're building elaborate redstone-free machines or just dropping explosions on your friends, Trapify is the tool for the job.

  • ✅ No coding required

  • ⚡ High performance

  • 👨‍💻 Power-user friendly, yet accessible to casual players

curseforge.name: Hitbox Visualiser - Utility
curseforge.summary: See what the game sees! Hitbox Visualizer allows you to see the exact collision boxes of every entity in your Minecraft world.
curseforge.description:
Hitbox Visualizer (v1.1.0)

See what the game sees! Hitbox Visualizer allows you to see the exact collision boxes of every entity in your Minecraft world. Whether you are a technical player testing farm mechanics, a map maker ensuring your mobs are perfect, or just curious, this pack gives you the vision you need.

✨ Features

  • See Hitboxes: A clean white box appears around every mob, showing exactly where they can be hit or collide.
  • View Direction: A blue arrow shows exactly where a mob is looking.
  • Lag Free: Unlike older packs that use particles, this uses modern game features to draw shapes instantly without slowing down your game.
  • Toggle On/Off: The pack is disabled by default so it doesn't clutter your view. Turn it on only when you need it!

📸 Screenshots & GIFs

(Its looking choppy now because of gif conversion and compression but its smoother ingame.)

Smoother (V1.1.0)

🎮 How to Use

  1. Install: Add the Behavior Pack to your world.
  2. Activate: Make sure "Beta APIs" is enabled in your world settings experiments.
  3. Play: Join the world.
  4. Toggle: Open the chat and type:
    • !hitbox
    • ...or simply !hb
  5. Done! You will see a message saying visualization is Enabled. Type it again to turn it off!

⚠️ Notes

  • Works in Singleplayer and Multiplayer.
  • Required "Beta APIs" experiment enabled.
  • Works in the Overworld, Nether, and End.

📜 Credits

  • Author: GamerFile

github.name: ultimine
github.summary: ultimine is an unofficial remake of java's FTB Ultimine for minecraft bedrock, leveraging Bedrock Script API
github.readme:
ultimine

ultimine is an unofficial remake of Java's FTB Ultimine for Minecraft Bedrock, leveraging the Bedrock Script API.

This repository contains the Bedrock scripting implementation and helper modules (see index.js, utils.js).

Features

  • Fast block mining behavior inspired by FTB Ultimine (Java edition)
  • Built using the Bedrock Script API for Bedrock Edition
  • Lightweight, script-driven implementation suitable for behavior packs

Requirements

  • Minecraft Bedrock Edition (version supporting the Script API)
  • A behavior pack environment that allows Bedrock scripts (experimental features may be required)

Installation

  1. Copy the contents of this repository into a behavior pack folder for your world or server.
  2. Ensure the behavior pack is added to your world and enabled.
  3. Enable any required experimental gameplay features so that the Bedrock Script API is available.

(If you use a specific tooling/packer for Bedrock add-ons, adapt these steps to your workflow.)

Usage

  • The main entry point is index.js. Load this script as part of your behavior pack's script configuration.
  • The code is organized with helper functions in utils.js.

For details about configuring scripts in a behavior pack, refer to the Bedrock Edition documentation for the Script API.

Development

  • This project is written in JavaScript. Edit the .js files and test by installing the behavior pack into a Bedrock instance.
  • Submit issues or pull requests if you find bugs or want to propose improvements.

Contributing

Contributions are welcome. Please open issues to discuss changes before sending larger pull requests.

License

See the LICENSE file in this repository for licensing information.

Contact

Raised issues on GitHub are the best way to report problems or request features.
